name: Pung.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Pung.io is a free IOGame. Pung is the arena, Pung is the fight, Pung is the weapon, and Pung is the game: the ultimate game. Welcome to the world of Pung.io where you will be forced to take on an arena full of real live players from around the world. It is punch or be punched in this game of ultra-violence and alpha competition. Pung.io will allow you to choose and customize your very own avatar, name it, and then jump into an arena filled with obstacles, enemies, weapons, and the opportunity to become the champion of them all. SSo, arm yourself, steady yourself, and prepare to enter a world of unmitigated punching, running, blocking, and winning. You can win all the time if you want but it will require that you sharpen your elbows and get punching. This is like the running of the bulls except with punches. This is the running of the punches and only you will have what it takes to throw the punches that will catch your opponents off guard enough to land a hit. You need to land hits and drop players if you wanna do the Rocky dance at the top of the leader board.
